item.title: Lawyers for New York man shot by ICE say officer fired into car without warning
item.description: Lawyers for a New York man shot and wounded by federal immigration officers while in a car with his young son say the officers never identified themselves or showed a warrant

item.title: Blockbuster-era law governing privacy of video rentals gets a fresh look from the Supreme Court
item.description: A 1988 law designed to protect the privacy of movie rentals in the age of Blockbuster Video is getting a fresh look from the Supreme Court

item.title: ICE rejects suggestion that its officers wear body cameras that automatically activate
item.description: A government report urges U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement to ensure body-worn cameras are activated when needed, suggesting automatic activation in certain situations

item.title: Shohei Ohtani batting 6th, a lone single, and the Dodgers staring at playoff elimination
item.description: Shohei Ohtani singled after being dropped to sixth in the batting order for the Los Angeles Dodgers

item.title: French soccer ethics body calls on fans to keep politics out of stadiums amid student protests
item.description: The ethics body of the French soccer federation has urged fans to stay neutral amid nationwide student protests

item.title: Rams lineman Alaric Jackson has suspension reduced to 1 game for punching Bills' Chubb
item.description: Los Angeles Rams offensive lineman Alaric Jackson to had his two-game suspension for punching a member of the Buffalo Bills reduced to one game on Wednesday after appealing the initial ruling

item.title: UK prosecutor labels Russell Brand a ruthless sexual predator as his sex assault trial begins
item.description: A British prosecutor has accused Russell Brand of being a “ruthless” sexual predator who assaulted six women over the course of a decade

item.title: Ukraine resumes attacks on Russian oil refineries, officials say, as US relations teeter
item.description: Officials say Ukraine has launched a drone and missile attack on a Russian oil refinery

item.title: New China-North Korea bridge opens after more than a decade of delay
item.description: A new bridge linking China and North Korea has opened after more than a decade of delay It's being touted as a symbol of the neighbors' traditional friendship and it signals deeper ties between the countries

item.title: IMF-World Bank meetings draw modest protests in Bangkok over growing inequality
item.description: Dozens of people have marched in Bangkok, seeking to draw the attention of world financial leaders to poverty, pollution and other grievances during a meeting of the International Monetary Fund and World Bank

item.title: Lawyers for Federal Reserve's Lisa Cook say White House hearing set up by Trump is 'biased'
item.description: Federal Reserve governor Lisa Cook’s lawyers say that a committee set up by the White House last week to investigate an accusation against her is “demonstrably biased,” though they did not close the door on the possibility that she would appear before the panel

item.title: GlobalFoundries to open 2 new chip plants in New York with $21 billion in financing from Japan
item.description: Semiconductor contract manufacturing and design company GlobalFoundries Inc. says it plans to open two chip-making factories in Malta, New York, financed by an investment of up to $21 billion from Japan

item.title: Zimbabwe’s Caine Prize winner rejects claim he used AI to write his story
item.description: Zimbabwean author Simbarashe Kundizeza denies using AI to write his short story, "The Blue Fighter," which won the $10,000 Caine Prize for African Writing

item.title: The building housing London's oldest restaurant has been donated to a conservation charity
item.description: The building that houses London’s oldest restaurant has been donated to Europe’s biggest conservation charity

item.title: South Korea embraces a huge shark slowly circling a canal in the country's biggest port city
item.description: A huge gray shark named Bukangi has become an honorary mascot in South Korea’s biggest port city
